assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: You promised the drivers this was a relief run.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: It is. We get their families fed, then we find who sealed Meridian.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Convoy, turn back, I cannot keep this road open for you.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: That voice. Voss, keep her on the channel. Do not let her disappear again.

assets.speaker: kerrigan
assets.heard: Drivers have names, Marshall. Try asking one.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Elias used to say that about the wounded.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: The drivers want to thank you. Will you come?

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: In a minute, play the transmission again.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: I am still here. Keep the others moving.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.

assets.speaker: kerrigan
assets.heard: Half these kids have never held a rifle. Your brother would have hated that.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Then teach them to come home. We have buried enough.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: Nyx was your friend. Tell me what happened before I send these children after her.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Elias called me from that gate. I told him I was coming.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: That recruit keeps checking whether you are watching.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Then, I had better give him something worth watching.

assets.speaker: kerrigan
assets.heard: The recruits are waiting at the rally point. You could say something.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Tell them I am proud. No, wait, I will tell them.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: I am still here. Keep the others moving.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: The relay archive has a medical channel from Meridian. It may be his.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Do not say that unless you are certain. I cannot do this twice.

assets.speaker: elias
assets.heard: Aegis, there are people against the gate. If you fire at it, you will hit them.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: I remember this part. Keep it playing. There has to be more.

assets.speaker: elias
assets.heard: If the gate opens, send the children first. I can wait.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: You always said that. You always thought there would be time.

assets.speaker: elias
assets.heard: Stop apologising. Just listen to me for once. Get the children out.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: That is what he asked of you. He never asked you to kill her.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: I am still here. Keep the others moving.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: The convoy has civilian trucks mixed in. We need another way.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: If Nyx crosses that river, we lose her. Mark the lead vehicle.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: There are children on the crossing. Stop firing.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: Ceasefire, Aegis, look at me, give the order.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: Those are blankets on the road, not camouflage.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Ceasefire, all guns. Voss, tell me somebody heard me.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: I saw the transport markings. I told myself they had stolen the trucks.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: You will say that to the survivors. I will not say it for you.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: I am still here. Keep the others moving.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.

assets.speaker: kerrigan
assets.heard: Voss asked me to watch you. Imagine that. After 20 years, I am your babysitter.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: You always were. You just used to complain less.

assets.speaker: kerrigan
assets.heard: The rear passage is gone. Do not bring the recruits back for me.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Dutch, you said you would watch me. You do not get to leave now.

assets.speaker: kerrigan
assets.heard: Tell Mara I still owe her a drink. She hates an unpaid debt.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: You can tell her yourself. Stay on this channel.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: He left a letter for his daughter. It is addressed in your handwriting.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: He asked me to write it before we left. I told him he would deliver it himself.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: I am still here, keep the others moving.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: I can open the spire, but if you destroy the controls the people below stay locked in.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: That was what you said at Meridian, that you were keeping people safe.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: I sealed it. I knew your brother was inside. I thought the order mattered more.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: I have rehearsed Killing You every night. I never rehearsed hearing you admit it.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: If you kill me, who tells Ilan what happened here?

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: I came here with a name. Now there are too many to carry.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Open the doors. Then you come with me. We both have people to answer to.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: I will stay on the channel. This time nobody has to make the call alone.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: I am still here, keep the others moving.

assets.speaker: aegis
assets.heard: Voss, get them home. That is the order I should have given.

assets.speaker: ilan
assets.heard: You said you would be home before the lights went out?

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: I know, leave the little lamp on, I will see it from the street.

assets.speaker: ren
assets.heard: The clinic is open but they will not let the families through.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Tell the guards I authorized it. If Arden asks, give him my name.

assets.speaker: ren
assets.heard: The clinic has power. They are still afraid to open the door.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Put the rifles down, let them see our hands.

assets.speaker: arden
assets.heard: You keep making exceptions for people you know.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Perhaps you should try knowing some of them.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Ren, cover me, I cannot lose them now.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Tell Ilan I tried to come back.

assets.speaker: arden
assets.heard: Aegis abandoned your district. We kept your son alive. Remember that when he calls.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: I remember who carried Ilan out, you do not need to keep reminding me.

assets.speaker: elias
assets.heard: Nyx, it is Elias. You fixed my radio last winter. Can you hear me?

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: I can hear you. Stay away from the gate. I am trying to get an override.

assets.speaker: elias
assets.heard: My brother is outside. Tell him I stayed with the patients.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: I will tell him. I thought I would have time to tell him.

assets.speaker: cantor
assets.heard: Gate sealed. Human override request denied.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Elias, keep talking. Please, say anything.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Ren, cover me, I cannot lose them now.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Tell Ilan I tried to come back.

assets.speaker: ren
assets.heard: Bastion has guns on the ridge. We could leave the civilian trucks and cross faster.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: No, I know what happens to the people we leave behind.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: There are children on the crossing. Stop firing.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Aegis, this is Nyx. You want me, I am in the rear vehicle.

assets.speaker: ren
assets.heard: Bastion is firing on its own relief markings.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Then the markings mean nothing. Follow the people.

assets.speaker: ren
assets.heard: You gave him your position. He could have killed you.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: I thought if he could see me, he might stop looking at the trucks.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Ren, cover me, I cannot lose them now.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Tell Ilan I tried to come back.

assets.speaker: cantor
assets.heard: District 9 is scheduled for pruning. Personal contacts do not change the schedule.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: My son lives there. Say his name before you say that again.

assets.speaker: ilan
assets.heard: Mum, Mrs. Vale cannot get down the stairs. They say we have to leave her.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Stay with her, put the phone in her hand, I am coming up.

assets.speaker: ilan
assets.heard: You said the system knew where everyone was.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: It knew. I am sorry. That was what I failed to understand.

assets.speaker: arden
assets.heard: After everything we gave you, you choose one street over the whole city.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: You taught me to say that about other people's streets. I am done saying it.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Ren, cover me, I cannot lose them now.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Tell Ilan I tried to come back.

assets.speaker: ren
assets.heard: Arden offered me your command if I bring you in.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: And what did you tell him?

assets.speaker: ren
assets.heard: That you still owe me three months of leave. I intend to collect.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Stay behind me at the door. I need you alive to make that complaint.

assets.speaker: arden
assets.heard: You cannot save a city by choosing one child.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: A city is made of people choosing one another.

assets.speaker: ilan
assets.heard: When the doors open, are you coming home?

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Not yet, there are people who need the truth from me. Keep the lamp though.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Ren, cover me, I cannot lose them now.

assets.speaker: nyx
assets.heard: Tell Ilan I tried to come back.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: You told Hask we could move 40 people. There are twice that many here.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: Then we make two trips. Stop counting like he does.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: One of the little ones asked if we were soldiers. I told her we fixed things.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: Good. Let us leave her something worth believing.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: Remember when you said this tunnel was too narrow for my rig?

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I am prepared to be wrong. Loudly. Just keep driving.

assets.speaker: hask
assets.heard: You went back after I ordered you out. I cannot protect you if you keep doing that.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I did not go back for your protection. Ren was still inside.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I need a hand. Nobody goes back alone.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: Ren take the wheel, get them out.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: When we reach the other side, you are sleeping. I can drive a truck without you watching.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: You hit one fence and I am never allowed to mention it again.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: There are children on the crossing. Stop firing.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: Wren, get below the axle. I am coming to you. Wren?

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: Rook, the back wheel is gone. I can hear people under the truck.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I am coming back, keep talking so I can find you.

assets.speaker: jory
assets.heard: I found her radio. There was nobody beside it.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: Then we keep looking. Do not put that look on your face. We keep looking.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I need a hand. Nobody goes back alone.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: Wren, take the wheel, get them out.

assets.speaker: jory
assets.heard: Their depot is full. Our wounded are using torn shirts. Tell me why we are waiting.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: We take the medicine and the records. The workers there are not your revenge.

assets.speaker: jory
assets.heard: The guard laughed when I said Cinder Ford. Let me have him.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: You are seventeen. I will not let him decide who you become.

assets.speaker: jory
assets.heard: Medicine does not make them answer for the Ford.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: No, it keeps someone alive long enough to hear the answer.

assets.speaker: jory
assets.heard: There is a Wren on the transfer list. Mechanic, sent east.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: Read it again, slowly. Do not make it kinder than it is.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I need a hand. Nobody goes back alone.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: REN, take the wheel, get them out.

assets.speaker: voss
assets.heard: I can hold the south road. I know you have no reason to trust my uniform.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I am trusting the person speaking. Do not make me regret learning your name.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: You took your time. I have had to repair this same generator four times.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I kept your radio. I did not know what else to do.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: You brought Bastion to get me out?

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I brought everyone who would come. Be angry when we are home.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: You do not have to watch the door all night. I am here.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I know. Give me a little while to believe it.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I need a hand, nobody goes back alone.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: Ren take the wheel, get them out.

assets.speaker: hask
assets.heard: Aegis will answer for the Ford, but if we break this alliance now, the prisoners stay inside.

assets.speaker: jory
assets.heard: You keep asking the dead to wait until it is convenient.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I wanted him dead too. Then I found Ren, and she needed a brother more than an executioner.

assets.speaker: jory
assets.heard: Mine is not coming back. You do not get to ask me to forgive him.

assets.speaker: hask
assets.heard: Peace will not bring back the people we buried.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: Neither will another grave. Open the corridor.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I am not asking you to forgive him. Help me get these people home. Then stand beside me when he answers.

assets.speaker: wren
assets.heard: We fix what we can, we remember what we cannot. Come on both of you.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: I need a hand. Nobody goes back alone.

assets.speaker: rook
assets.heard: Wren, take the wheel, get them out.
